title: CreateFeedSpecification
description: Information required to create the feed.

marketplaceIds.description: A list of identifiers for marketplaces that you want the feed to be applied to.

inputFeedDocumentId.description: The document identifier returned by the createFeedDocument operation. Upload the feed document contents before calling the createFeed operation.

FeedOptions.description: Additional options to control the feed. These vary by feed type.
